note: One query resolving a page of subjects, plus one alias in a repository that does not exist. GitHub answers HTTP 200 with the rest of the data present and a single NOT_FOUND naming the failed alias in its `path` — which is why omaghy_api::graphql::decode_partial exists alongside decode. Compare X-RateLimit-Used against the request before it: a whole page costs one point.
